dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: It's a holiday on Friday. Let's do something fun!
dialogue.reading: ɪts ə ˈhɑːlədeɪ ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ. ˈlɛts ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈfʌn!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: How about having a picnic in the park?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ əˈbaʊt ˈhævɪŋ ə ˈpɪknɪk ɪn ðə ˈpɑːrk?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good idea! But it might rain on Friday.
dialogue.reading: ˌɡʊd aɪˈdiːə! bʌt ɪt maɪt ˈreɪn ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then why don't we sing karaoke at the mall?
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈwaɪ ˈdoʊnt wiː ˈsɪŋ ˌkɛriˈoʊki ət ðə ˈmɔːl?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's OK. I sing badly, too!
dialogue.reading: ðæts oʊˈkeɪ. aɪ ˈsɪŋ ˈbædli, ˈtuː!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK! Let's invite Ploy, too. She always suggests fun places.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ! ˈlɛts ɪnˈvaɪt ˈplɔɪ, ˈtuː. ʃiː ˈɔːlweɪz səɡˈdʒɛsts ˈfʌn ˈpleɪsɪz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Good idea! I'll call her now.
dialogue.reading: ˌɡʊd aɪˈdiːə! aɪl ˈkɔːl hɜːr ˈnaʊ.
